_comment: Core-specific. The main CPU's view of the machine, from the MAME driver's address map (vamphalf.cpp common_map, misncrft). Read by mame_capture.py, write_timing.py and the e1 trace tools. Addresses are hex strings, inclusive. Wivern Wings differs: bus_bytes 4, common_32bit_map, I/O map wyvernwg_io.
_sweep_regions_comment: Extra named ranges for write_timing.py. Sprite RAM split: spr_bands = the 17 bands of 0x800 bytes (0x8800); spr_used = bands 1..15, the only bytes draw_sprites reads; spr_rest = past the 17 bands. io_flip taps the I/O space (name prefix io_).

io_space._comment: AS_IO of the E1-16: 16-bit data, 13 address bits, address unit is a 16-bit word (e1 config shift -1). I/O reads are not in the program-space sys trace; scripts/mame/e1trace.lua taps this space.
io_space.name: io

video._comment: I/O address of the flip write (flipscreen_w: flip = data & 1). vamphalf.cpp misncrft_io 0x040, wyvernwg_io 0x0800.

wivernwg._sweep_regions_comment: Extra named ranges for write_timing.py. Sprite RAM split: spr_bands = the 17 bands of 0x800 bytes (0x8800); spr_used = bands 1..15, the only bytes draw_sprites reads; spr_rest = past the 17 bands. io_flip taps the I/O space (name prefix io_).

inputs._comment2: A single coin pulse is not credited by either set (see scripts/mame/vcap.lua); the coin is repeated every coin_period frames from the first coin frame, Start every start_period frames from 90 frames later, each held press_len frames.
